exposure: Ethanolic extract of Bintangur leaves (Calophyllum soulattri Burm. F) at 100 mg/kg BW
Ethanolic extract of Bintangur leaves (Calophyllum soulattri Burm. F) at 500 mg/kg BW
cohort: Pregnant Sprague Dawley strain white rats divided into four treatment groups.
finding: Ethanolic extract of Bintangur leaves (CLE) at both 100 mg/kg BW and 500 mg/kg BW did not demonstrate teratogenic effects, showing no significant changes in the number of living fetuses, fetal body weight, fetal length, or skeletal formation, compared to the control group.
birth_weight: Fetal body weight was measured and analyzed.
